## Constraints

### Must

- Use the existing pink FloV:MP accent and dark tokens.
- Use Lucide icons.
- Keep motion subtle and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Keep Russian and English content fully separated.

### Avoid

- SaaS wording in public product copy.
- Gaming-clan and cyberpunk visual clichés.
- Decorative fake metrics.
- Background-filled hover states for primary navigation links.

## Decisions

- Public positioning focuses on an independent GTA V multiplayer platform.
- Header navigation uses subtle typographic scale and contrast without background fills.
- Feature grids use complete equal-width rows without empty bento cells.
